title: All caught up for… 2 days #broadway #nationaltour #aladdin #disneythe...
transcript: Come with me as I hit a fun theater milestone. Move over, Dan. My Name is Kate, and as of tonight, I will have seen every show on Broadway. Except that I'm seeing this one in Denver, because I count national tours. I got some pre show raising canes, checked out the gorgeous day in Colorado, and headed up to Denver for the national tour of Aladdin, which somehow I've gone the past 12 years without seeing a single version of. Well, other than the version of the Hyperion at Disney California Adventure, which I have seen. I don't know why it took me this long to go see Aladdin, because I had an absolute blast. Is this definitely a kid show? Yeah, and there's some changes from the movie that not everyone's going to love, like there's no animals in this. But I honestly really enjoyed the changes. I really enjoyed the new songs, and I thought the dance numbers were a blast. Out of all of the Disney musicals, I can see why this one has been so successful and why it's run on Broadway for the last 12 years. Show is super fun, this cast is so super talented, and I got to meet Aaron from TikTok, who plays Iago on the tour. I added this applause to my shoe box and called it a successful night of theater going.
classificationReason: Creator attended the national tour of Aladdin and shares clear first-hand opinions ('absolute blast,' 'super fun,' cast 'super talented'). National tour of the Broadway production listed as aladdin-2014.
